name: Paraíso
description: Marked by the reputation of “son of the devil”, Zeca sees his life change when he falls in love with Maria Rita, Santinha. But the young woman's devotion and expectations about her destiny put the romance to the test.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Zeca returns to his father's farm. Mariana accuses Antero of being responsible for Maria Rita no longer performing miracles. Santinha goes to a child's home to pray for the child.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Maria Rita weeps over the child's death. Rosinha thinks of Zeca. Geraldo waits for Maria Rosa at the church entrance, but she turns him away. Father Bento complains about the offertory collection.
